name: Geizhals (DE/AT price comparison and merchant routing)
vendor: NVIDIA / Intel / AMD board partners (many EU merchants)
region: Germany / Austria (listings also ship to other EU states)
notes: availability is 'unknown' at the channel level because Geizhals aggregates ~30 EU merchants whose stock states differ per listing - only the per-SKU 'Auf Lager' markers are reliable. Not a seller: Geizhals is a price aggregator that routes to ~30 EU merchants, which is why it is the best available read on EU price bands and stock state. EUR figures observed 2026-10-03, all incl. VAT excl. shipping, and deliberately NOT converted to USD here because no exchange rate was sourced: RTX 5090 ASUS ROG Astral from EUR 5,131.85 (13 offers, top of list EUR 7,424.00); RTX 4090 Founders Edition at EUR 3,989.99; Arc B580 ASRock Challenger from EUR 314.90 (per-shop shipping EUR 4.99-9.99, free above EUR 500 order value); ASUS ROG Strix RTX 3090 showing 'Auf Lager' but with the page-level price field empty on the day. For RDNA4 consumer boards it shows a GIGABYTE RX 9070 XT Gaming OC from EUR 757.16, close to the US $829.99 seen at B&H. Fetch reliability was poor: many requests returned an anti-bot error, and the list views intermittently omitted prices that the product pages carried.
